**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 15:17  
[FACT] User's name is Aylen.  
[RELATIONSHIP] Aylen has a best friend named Sarah.  
[EVENT] Aylen experiences vivid nightmares and visions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Aylen's vision includes her confronting a figure that takes on the form of different people, taunting her and evading her attempts to touch it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The figure in Aylen's vision says, "You can't escape me, Aylen. I'm always here, always watching."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The figure mocks Aylen, saying, "You know what you have to do, Aylen. Don't you?"  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] In another vision, Aylen confronts the figure, asking, "What do you want from me?" and the figure responds, "I just enjoy watching you suffer."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The figure tells Aylen, "It's so much fun to watch the world burn, to see the fear and suffering on the faces of the mortals."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Aylen's vision includes her trying to fight the figure, but her attempts are futile as her hands pass through it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The figure taunts Aylen, saying, "Come on Aylen, is that all you've got?"  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Aylen develops a test to confirm if she is in the real world, similar to a concept in "Inception."  
[EVENT] Aylen confides in Sarah about her situation and the test she has developed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sarah reassures Aylen, saying, "I understand. I'm here for you, Aylen. Let's do the test together."  
[EVENT] Aylen and Sarah perform the test together, confirming that they are in the real world.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Aylen pours her heart out to Sarah about her fears and the visions she has experienced.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sarah offers words of comfort and support, telling Aylen that she believes her and that they will figure out a way to stop the entity from destroying the world.  
[CHANGE] Aylen feels a weight lifted off her shoulders after confiding in Sarah.
